messages:
maria: quick alert — onboarding sample-app blocked for demo. JSON mode tool calls sometimes arrive as a stringified JSON and fail schema validation.
aj: that sounds like the auth-retry path doing an extra stringify. seen similar parity issues.
kai: can you paste the exact log?
maria: log: ```
2026-03-21T09:41:02Z ERROR validator: failed to parse tool output: JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
raw_body: \"{\\\"cmd\\\": \\\"apply\\\", \\\"args\\\": [1,2,],}\"
```
ellie: two problems: model left a trailing comma and the body is double-encoded (string containing JSON).
aj: my guess: JS retry shim does `JSON.stringify(toolResponse)` before replaying the call; py version keeps the object. unit tests didn't catch because mocks coerce types.
kai: i'll add a parity integration that simulates 401 then ensures the retried transport receives the same object shape (no extra stringify) and that streaming mode is preserved.
maria: mitigation plan: patch JS SDK retry wrapper to preserve the original toolArgs shape; add a conditional sanitizer that strips trailing commas only when parse fails, behind SANITIZE_TOOL_OUTPUT flag.
ellie: also add sample-app middleware to log raw body on validation errors so we can see malformed payloads for customers. update README.
aj: i'll open a PR with the fix + unit + integration tests + changelog. ETA EOD.
devrel-bot: Issue created: DEVEX-4801 "json-mode: double-encoded toolcalls on auth retry + trailing-comma heuristic" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEVEX-4801
kai: i'll run some prompt fuzzing to measure how often the model emits trailing commas; if frequent we escalate to model team.
maria: thanks — once PR landed we'll run onboarding smoke suite against sample-app + JS SDK in JSON mode to prevent regressions.
